title: Costs rebuild 2 · piece 6: stop posting [usage] snapshots; remove the runner snapshot path
description:
**Piece 6 of LIN-4195.** Start it only after piece 4 is live and measured, and piece 5 has landed, so every producer posts records.

**Runner (simple-dispatcher):**

* Stop posting `[usage]` snapshots: remove `postUsageSnapshot` and `walkUsage`'s cumulative total.
* In opencode, remove `usageDelta`/`fetchSessionRollup` and `postUsageFeedback`'s snapshot post if nothing else uses them.
* Remove tests that pin those functions (the ticket permits this).
* Update `docs/runner-prompt.md` (\~:180, the `[usage]` instruction) in Harbour.

**runner-kit:** stop its `[usage]` snapshot post if piece 5's records now cover it.

**Harbour:**

* **Keep** the legacy snapshot fold for old rows (D8: no translation, no backfill).
* Confirm the `/kpis` harness shares (review note 1) do not drift toward `unknownHarnessShare` = 100% as new lineages stop carrying `[usage]` entries.

**Measure:** re-run piece 3's live measurement. Report on LIN-4195 the share of runner work Harbour can price, before (piece 3) and after.

**Acceptance:**

* No producer posts `[usage]` snapshots.
* Old snapshot rows still read correctly: the replay's snapshot-only controls are unchanged.
* The live share is reported.

**Then write LIN-4195's final report-back**, under the ticket's headings: What changed / What was left, and why / What still looks fuzzy / Follow-ups (listed, not filed). The follow-ups include:

* delete the legacy fold and the digest's frozen cost 30 days after this piece;
* `llm-call-log` F7/F8;
* the lean/frozen digest `costUsd`.

---

**Parent:** LIN-4195 "Costs rebuild 2: one record per model request, summed". Its full design (decisions D1–D14, the replay change list, the witnesses, the order of landing) is in LIN-4195's description under "## Implementation Plan". The plan-review notes are in LIN-4195's comment `eedab867-0fe0-4b15-b74a-2b78240f11d1`. The numbered notes cited here ("review note N") refer to that comment.

Session fit: fits one session
Plan-review due: no — covered by LIN-4195's approving plan-review (comment eedab867-0fe0-4b15-b74a-2b78240f11d1, rev 1)
Grounding commits: Harbour (JKershaw/LinearViewer) `72305215`, runner (JKershaw/simple-dispatcher) `cc2650a`. At breakdown (2026-11-04 \~01:45Z) neither repo had a commit after these.

The parent's approved plan is this piece's starting point; read it in full in LIN-4195's description. Follow it. Where the code shows it is wrong, change course and say so on LIN-4195.

## Implementation record (close-out, 4 Nov)

The Survey ("How to go about it") and the Periodicals drift note are discharged and removed here; the full text is preserved in the task snapshots (capture of 2026-11-04T17:45Z) and the comment trail.

* **Implemented as approved**, no deviations from the scope decision below: runner PR [https://github.com/JKershaw/simple-dispatcher/pull/323](<https://github.com/JKershaw/simple-dispatcher/pull/323>) (merge `44ab30ec`) and Harbour PR [https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2274](<https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2274>) (merge `d7ceb373`, deployed).
* `postUsageSnapshot` and its seven call sites, `walkUsage`, and the opencode snapshot path are gone; runner-kit posts records only; the `[usage]` line is out of `docs/runner-prompt.md`. The legacy fold stays (D8, not before 2026-12-04) and a `usage-snapshot-intake` counter counts old `kind:'usage'` posts without rejecting them.
* The Drift #9 flag question (`usage-relay-flag-partial`) was decided: `SD_WORKER_USAGE_RELAY` gates every record flush at one chokepoint (`flushRequestUsage`).
* Not this task's, listed on LIN-4195's final report-back: legacy-fold deletion 30 days on, one shared transcript fold, `hook.js` Stop-sequence refactor, the D14 issue-attribution rule.

### Scope decision (4 Nov, 11:15 UTC)

John asked Claude to take the human's role in this process and choose a large enough option. **The decision: the recommended shape (delete, and leave a checkable boundary, plus the intake counter), and decide the flag.** `SD_WORKER_USAGE_RELAY` should mean one thing: either it gates every record flush (including the five seams Drift found), or it is retired. Record which, with the reason.

**The one Stop sequence in** `hook.js` **is decided too: it's its own ticket, sequenced right after this one.** A pricing follow-up (LIN-4150, "Survey pricing: LIN-4203") found that doing it first buys this ticket almost nothing, since the seven snapshot lines are identical. Folding it in would mix a refactor with a behaviour change. This ticket makes the refactor cheaper. Don't do it here; it's filed separately, with a characterization golden first.

comments.body:
## LIN-4203 (piece 6): build complete, PRs open, CI green

**PRs**
- Runner: https://github.com/JKershaw/simple-dispatcher/pull/323 (`ccaf999`). CI `unit tests` pass.
- Harbour: https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2274 (`ec3b4800`). CI `Unit tests`, all 4 E2E shards, secret scan and `CI success` pass.

**What changed**
- Runner: `postUsageSnapshot` and its 7 Stop call sites, `walkUsage`, and the opencode snapshot path (`postUsageFeedback`, `fetchSessionRollup`, `usageDelta`, baseline) are removed. Records are unchanged.
- `SD_WORKER_USAGE_RELAY` decision: it now gates the record flush at one chokepoint (`flushRequestUsage`). Before, the fail, cancel and reap seams flushed records even with the flag off. Kept as a flag, not retired, so operators keep a kill switch.
- Harbour: runner-kit's `usage` command posts records only. The `[usage]` instruction is removed from `docs/runner-prompt.md`. The legacy fold is kept (D8, no backfill), marked LEGACY, and removal is due 30 days after deploy.
- Harbour: new intake counter (`usage-snapshot-intake`). An old runner's `kind:'usage'` post is still accepted and counted per workspace per UTC day, so "no producer posts [usage]" is a query. The counter is best-effort and never changes the feedback result.

**Verification**
- Runner `npm test`: 4221 pass, 0 fail, 5 skipped. Mutation check: removing the flush gate fails both flag-off witnesses (observed).
- Runner `npm run test:system`: 2 failures (`observation-feed`, `tap1-openrouter`). The same 2 fail on clean HEAD with `HARBOUR_DIR` pinned, so they predate this change.
- Harbour `npm run test:unit`: 23072 pass, 0 fail. Mutation check: re-adding the snapshot post to runner-kit fails the inverted witness (observed, then restored).

**Not done / open**
- Post-deploy live re-measure (piece 3 method) is NOT run. This session has no production Mongo credential, and piece 6 is not deployed. It needs a read-only run of `scripts/lin-4200-measure-records-vs-snapshots.mjs` after deploy.
- Ruling needed (John): a subagent with no readable transcript now posts nothing. It used to post a harness-only `[usage]`, which read "harness known, unpriced". It now reads as no usage. The Survey recommends `no-usage`, and I took that, but it is a shared-path change.
- Deploy order: Harbour (the counter and runner-kit change) before the runner.

## Review — LIN-4203

Reviewed runner https://github.com/JKershaw/simple-dispatcher/pull/323 at head `ccaf9998b3adfb6d1a1cf8f49be11f04ce8d2ba8`, and Harbour https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2274 at head `ec3b4800d449e866cefd86ab04d15ab097c11cc7`. Both branches contain current `origin/main` (runner `7d515d3`, Harbour `2ee4e600`), and both PRs are MERGEABLE.

CI: green on both heads. Runner: `unit tests` pass. Harbour: `Unit tests`, E2E shards 1–4, `Secret scan (source)` and `CI success` pass.

### Scope against the at-merge shape (from the ticket)
- **Runner, removed:** `postUsageSnapshot` and its 7 Stop call sites, `walkUsage` and its export, and opencode's `postUsageFeedback`, `fetchSessionRollup`, `usageDelta` and the `usageBaseline`/`postUsageDelta` closure. A grep for any remaining `kind:'usage'` or `[usage]` producer in non-test runner code finds only two comments.
- **Harbour, removed:** runner-kit's `sumTranscriptUsage`, `usageMessage` and the `[usage]` post. The `[usage]` line is gone from `docs/runner-prompt.md`, and the parse test keeps it as `LEGACY_USAGE_FIXTURE`. In Harbour `lib/`, `routes/`, `scripts/` and `public/`, only readers of `kind:'usage'` remain, so the class is closed: there is no other producer.
- **Flag (Drift #9, `usage-relay-flag-partial`):** I confirmed the "gate it everywhere" decision in code. All five SD seams the drift review named (`dispatcher.js:478`, `:616`, `:1175`, and `reapers.js:1894`, `:3989`) call `flushRequestUsageDetached`, which calls `flushRequestUsage`. That function now returns before any read or post when `WORKER_USAGE_RELAY` is off. The Stop seam reaches the same function. Opencode's poster is reached only through `relayRequestRecords`, which checks `workerUsageRelay` first. The flag is re-documented in `config.js`, the README, `hook.js` and `docs/module-map.md`. One flag now has one meaning.
- **Legacy fold:** kept, with LEGACY / D8 / "not before 2026-12-04" comments on `usageStateOf`, `isRunningTotal` and `countedRowsOf`. There is no translation and no backfill.
- **Intake counter:** `lib/usage-snapshot-intake.js` keeps one `_id` upsert per workspace per day. It runs after the feedback write has landed, inside its own try/catch, and never rejects a post. It needs no index (point upsert on `_id`).
- **`hook.js` Stop-sequence refactor:** correctly left out.
- **Opencode seam golden:** the golden is kept, and its `kind:'usage'` entries are filtered out when comparing, with an explicit "zero usage posts at any site" assertion. The ticket said "re-recorded". This approach is equivalent and the mutation below shows it pins the behaviour. Not a finding.

### Regression check
The `git log` on `hook.js`, `opencode-runner.js`, `request-usage-flush.js`, `transcript.js`, `runner.mjs`, `dispatch-store.js`, `row-usage.js` and `cost-read.js` shows no revert, and no earlier fix that this change undoes. The LIN-3229 per-field-max fold, which `walkUsage` had, survives in `request-usage.js` and in runner-kit's `foldTranscriptMessages`. Only the snapshot consumer of that fold was removed. The LIN-2835 "final turn only" bug cannot come back: the per-message `info` is still not used as a usage source.

### Mutation checks (each reverted afterwards; the working trees are clean)
1. **Runner:** I deleted `if (!WORKER_USAGE_RELAY) return NOTHING;` from `flushRequestUsage`. Two tests went red: "flag OFF: a reap-seam flush posts no request record…" and "…explicitly 0, the same DONE Stop posts neither a record nor a snapshot". The baseline is 64/64 across the five targeted files.
2. **Runner:** I re-added a `kind:'usage'` feedback post on the DONE Stop branch of `hook.js`. Both `worker-usage-default` witnesses went red.
3. **Runner (opencode):** I re-added a `kind:'usage'` `sendFeedback` before `relayRecords('normal-end')`. Six tests in `lin-4202-opencode-records.test.js` went red.
4. **Harbour:** I disabled the counter branch in `addFeedback`. "a kind:usage post lands in the feedback and is counted" went red. The baseline is 292/292 across the five targeted files.
5. **Harbour:** I re-added the `[usage]` post in runner-kit's `usage` command. Two tests went red: "usage posts no kind:usage snapshot…" and "a failing record post is reported… and still no snapshot is posted".

Test level is right for the change. The Stop-hook witnesses drive the real `main()` against a fake Harbour, and the counter test goes through the real `DispatchQueueStore.addFeedback`. What only production can show is in the ledger below.

### Small fixes for close-out (comments only, no behaviour change)
- `simple-dispatcher/test/opencode-runner.test.js:2114-2116`: the comment says an ambient `SD_WORKER_USAGE_RELAY` "adds a GET /session/:id to every call list". That roll-up GET is gone. Reword it to say the relay adds the records relay's message read.
- `simple-dispatcher/request-usage.js:159`: "Billing lane detection for the [usage] payload" should become "Billing lane detection for the request records' `lane`".
- LIN-4195's final report-back lists "Ruling needed (John): no-usage versus harness-only". I found no ruling row for it (rulings on LIN-4203: 0; on LIN-4195: three answered rows, none on this). The 11:15 scope decision on this ticket adopted "the recommended shape", and that shape lists `sumTranscriptUsage` as **Gone**. So the `no-usage` semantic is already decided by that delegation. Close-out should edit the report-back to say so, and add the effect on coverage shares: a subagent with no readable transcript now posts no record. Its lineage reads as no reported usage, so it is not counted as an unpriced known-harness lineage. A new ruling should not be raised.

### What CI Did Not Prove
- **Live share after piece 6 (inside: acceptance criterion "The live share is reported").** Settle after the deploy. Once both PRs are deployed (Harbour first, then the runner), run `scripts/lin-4200-measure-records-vs-snapshots.mjs` read-only over a window that starts after the runner deploy. Then replace the "After piece 6: **pending**" line in LIN-4195's report-back with the figures. The result is right if every lineage started after the runner deploy is record-backed, there are 0 snapshot-only lineages and 0 orphan records, and the records priced share stays at 100% as it was after piece 4.
- **"No producer posts `[usage]`" in production (inside: acceptance criterion 1).** Use the named monitor `usage-snapshot-intake`, which fires on any post. After the runner deploy and restart, the `count` for each `linearviewer:<day>` document dated after the deploy should be 0 or absent. A non-zero count means an old runner process (or an unmigrated host) is still posting. This is a monitor rather than a test because CI cannot see which runner binaries are live on hosts. Deploy order matters only for the measurement window: the counter has to be live before the runner stops posting.
- **`/kpis` harness shares do not drift toward `unknownHarnessShare` = 100% (inside: the ticket's Harbour bullet).** The code path is covered: a record lineage always reads a known harness (`lin-4201-records-first-read.test.js:242-256`). The live residual is lineages with neither records nor a snapshot, which is the transcript-less subagent above. Settle after the deploy: read `/kpis` for linearviewer and check that `unknownHarnessShare` is not above its piece-4 value.
- **Real producers end to end (inside).** No CI job runs a real Claude Code Stop hook, a real `opencode serve` or a real runner-kit subagent against Harbour. This is settled by the same post-deploy measurement as the first item: runner-kit and opencode lineages after the deploy should appear as record-backed.
- **Rollback.** Revert runner merge commit (#323) and Harbour merge commit (#2274). Both reverts are clean: the counter collection is additive, and the legacy fold still reads snapshots, so a reverted runner's snapshots read as before. For a records-only kill switch without a revert, set `SD_WORKER_USAGE_RELAY=0`. Note that after this change that switch posts **nothing** (no snapshot fallback), so it is a kill switch, not a rollback to snapshots.
- **Runner `npm run test:system` failures `observation-feed` and `tap1-openrouter` (outside).** The implementer reports both also fail on clean HEAD. I did not re-run them. They are not this ticket's problem. Close-out should check whether a ticket already covers them before filing one.
- **Counter not on the account-erasure list (outside).** It holds only `urlKey`/day counts, the same shape as `wake-shadow`, which is also not erasure-listed. This is not personal data, and nothing is needed here.

### Verdict
Approve — conditional on close-out discharging the ledger. The work matches the planned shape. All five drifted seams are now gated at one chokepoint, every load-bearing witness went red under mutation, and CI is green on both heads. What remains is the post-deploy live share and the intake-counter monitor, plus the three comment-level fixes above.

## Close-out — LIN-4203

**Merged** (review Approve on record, `1f44d937`; both PRs merged pinned to the commit CI passed on)
- Harbour https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2274: head `ec3b4800`, merge `d7ceb373`. CI green on that exact head (Unit tests, E2E 1–4, Secret scan, CI success). Deployed: harbour.cat footer shows `d7ceb373`.
- Runner https://github.com/JKershaw/simple-dispatcher/pull/323: head `fe3e32b8`, merge `44ab30ec`. CI `unit tests` green on that exact head (re-run after my commit).
- Harbour merged first, as the deploy order required.

**Changes I made after the approval** (comment-only; no behaviour change)
- `fe3e32b8` (runner): `test/opencode-runner.test.js:2114-2116` now says the relay adds the records relay's message read (answers review "Small fixes", bullet 1). `request-usage.js:159` now says lane detection feeds the request records' `lane` (bullet 2). Re-ran `test/opencode-runner.test.js` under the `npm test` preloads: 190/190 pass; full CI re-run green on `fe3e32b8`.
- Review bullet 3 (LIN-4195 report-back): edited comment `5f57c45b` to say the `no-usage` semantic was decided by the 11:15Z scope delegation and to state its effect on the coverage shares. No new ruling raised.

**Ledger**
- *Live share after piece 6 (inside):* **NOT run.** Needs production Mongo read access, which this session lacks (Railway CLI is logged in as John but unlinked; the earlier route needed an SSH key and exposed the root password, see LIN-4195). Also the window must start after the runner deploy, which I could not confirm. Recorded as not run on the PR comments and in LIN-4195's report-back, with the expected result. Who can run it: John or an operator, read-only, `scripts/lin-4200-measure-records-vs-snapshots.mjs`.
- *No `[usage]` producer in production (inside), monitor `usage-snapshot-intake`:* **NOT read**, same access reason. Expected: `count` 0/absent for each `linearviewer:<day>` document dated after the runner deploy. A non-zero count means an old runner process is still posting.
- *`/kpis` harness share (inside):* checked on the deployed page (`d7ceb373`): "with an unknown runner" 4%, the same as the pre-deploy page, so no drift toward 100%. Weak evidence, since the runner deploy is unconfirmed and no lineage has stopped carrying snapshots yet; the code path is pinned by `lin-4201-records-first-read.test.js:242-256`.
- *Real producers end to end (inside):* covered by the same post-deploy re-measure, not run.
- *Rollback:* cited from the review: revert #323 and #2274 (both clean); `SD_WORKER_USAGE_RELAY=0` is a records kill switch that posts nothing.
- *Runner `test:system` failures `observation-feed` and `tap1-openrouter` (outside):* already ticketed as LIN-4187 and LIN-4188; linked as `related` on this ticket, no new ticket filed.
- *Counter not on the erasure list (outside):* nothing needed, per review.

**Final CI state:** green on both merged heads (Harbour `ec3b4800`, runner `fe3e32b8`). Harbour's post-merge `Tests` run on `d7ceb373` also succeeded.

**Left for the operator** (not a reason to hold the close; the deploy landed): run the re-measure and the counter read after the runner is deployed and its processes restarted; the runner deploy itself is not confirmed by me.

**Follow-ups:** listed on LIN-4195's final report-back (legacy fold deletion not before 2026-12-04, counter deletion, `llm-call-log` F7/F8, digest `costUsd`), not filed, as this ticket directs.
